managePayments.heading: Payments
managePayments.state.not_connected.title: Not set up
managePayments.state.not_connected.body: Takes about 10 minutes. You will need your bank details and an identity document.
managePayments.state.requirements.title: Stripe is asking for your details
managePayments.state.requirements.body: Card payments will not work until Stripe gets your business details and bank details.
managePayments.state.pending.title: Connected — Stripe is checking your details
managePayments.state.pending.body: You don’t need to do anything. Stripe is reviewing what you sent, and this page will update when they finish.
managePayments.state.ready.title: Connected
managePayments.state.ready.body: Your Stripe account is connected and can take payments.
managePayments.state.restricted.title: Card payments are paused
managePayments.state.restricted.body: Stripe has paused card payments on your account until something is resolved.
managePayments.state.unsupported.title: Card payments are not available on this account
managePayments.state.unsupported.body: Stripe cannot enable card payments here. Get in touch and we will sort it out together.
managePayments.keyMismatch.title: The Stripe keys do not match
managePayments.keyMismatch.body: This site’s server uses a {server, select, live {production} other {test}} Stripe key, while the browser was built with a {browser, select, live {production} other {test}} key. Card payments would fail the moment a customer tries to pay, so setting up Stripe is blocked until the two keys match.
managePayments.keyMismatch.fix: Both keys must be set for the same environment, and the site then rebuilt — the public key (publishable key) is built in at build time, the secret key is read on every request.
managePayments.permission.title: Only the food truck’s owner can set up payments
managePayments.permission.body: Stripe connects the person whose bank account receives the money, so setup must be done from their own logged-in account. Nothing is wrong with this food truck or with HatchGrab.

managePayments.online.heading: Online payments

managePayments.online.feeLine: Stripe charges {fee} per payment with standard {region}. Other cards may cost more. HatchGrab’s fee for online orders depends on your plan — see “Billing”.

managePayments.trialNote: Setting this up does not start your subscription and charges you nothing today. It is how customers pay you — your plan is a separate thing.

managePayments.walkUp.ownTerminalHelp: Zettle, Square or whatever you already use. Nothing to set up — only your provider’s fees apply.

managePayments.walkUp.hatchgrabFees: {fee} per payment with {region}, plus {surcharge} for contactless payments taken on a phone or tablet. Other cards may cost more.

manageWhatsApp.notice.setupFailed: Setup could not be completed. Nothing was changed.
manageWhatsApp.notice.metaError: Meta reported a problem during setup. Nothing was changed. Try again, and contact us if it keeps happening.
manageWhatsApp.notice.closed: Setup was closed before it finished. Nothing was changed — press “Set up” to try again.

manageWhatsApp.card.title: Auto-replies
manageWhatsApp.card.description: Answer customer questions automatically on your social media, using your menu and schedule.
manageWhatsApp.card.requiresAccount: A WhatsApp Business account is required.
manageWhatsApp.card.popupInstruction: A Facebook window will open so you can connect your WhatsApp Business account. If nothing appears, allow pop-ups for hatchgrab.com in your browser, then press “Set up” again.

manageWhatsApp.card.expiring: Your WhatsApp connection needs renewing soon. Press “Reconnect” so auto-replies keep working.
manageWhatsApp.card.instagram: Auto-replies to Instagram direct messages. An Instagram professional account will be required.
manageWhatsApp.card.messenger: Auto-replies on Facebook Messenger. A Facebook page will be required.
manageWhatsApp.blocked.title: Your replies are not reaching customers
manageWhatsApp.blocked.body: WhatsApp is refusing to send your automatic replies because of a payment problem on your WhatsApp Business account. Customers can still write to you and you will still see everything they send — but they are not getting a reply.
manageWhatsApp.blocked.fix: You pay WhatsApp directly for these messages, so this is fixed in WhatsApp Manager. <link>Check your payment method</link>
manageWhatsApp.limit.heading: Auto-replies
manageWhatsApp.limit.label: Monthly limit

manageWhatsApp.limit.perCustomer: Maximum replies per customer in 24 hours: {n}; then one message saying you will reply personally.
manageWhatsApp.limit.emailAt: Replies pause when you reach the limit. We will email you at 80% and 100%.
manageWhatsApp.limit.saved: The monthly reply limit has been saved
manageWhatsApp.limit.saveFailed: The limit could not be saved

manageWhatsApp.billing.chargesTitle: Meta charges for WhatsApp replies, not HatchGrab.
manageWhatsApp.billing.chargesBody: Each reply HatchGrab sends on your behalf is charged by Meta to your WhatsApp Business account. From {from}, Meta includes free replies a month per number: {free, number}; after that each reply is charged at Meta’s price. Replies you send yourself from the WhatsApp Business app are not charged. Meta sets these prices and may change them. <link>See Meta’s prices</link>
manageWhatsApp.billing.addPaymentInManag: Add a payment method in WhatsApp Manager
manageWhatsApp.billing.aboveMissing: Your limit is above Meta’s free replies ({free, number}). Without a payment method, Meta will stop all replies once those are used up.
manageWhatsApp.billing.aboveGeneral: Your limit is above Meta’s free replies ({free, number}). Replies beyond that need a payment method on your WhatsApp account; without one, Meta stops all replies once the free ones are used up.
manageWhatsApp.disconnect.title: Disconnect WhatsApp?
manageWhatsApp.disconnect.body: Auto-replies stop at once and HatchGrab loses access to your WhatsApp account. Your number keeps working in the WhatsApp Business app. To remove HatchGrab completely, also open WhatsApp Business → “Settings” (Settings) → “Account” (Account) → Business Platform.
manageWhatsApp.disconnect.failed: The connection could not be cut
manageWhatsApp.signup.partial: We linked your WhatsApp Business account but could not complete the connection. Nothing is wrong on your side — contact us and we will finish it.
manageWhatsApp.signup.noNumber: Your WhatsApp Business account is linked, but no phone number came back. Press “Reconnect” and finish the number step.
manageWhatsApp.signup.needsRegistering: Your account is linked, but we need to register this number before replies can start. Contact support — your setup is saved, do not repeat it.
manageWhatsApp.signup.registerRefused: Your account is linked, but Meta would not register the number. The setup is saved — contact support instead of going through it again.
manageWhatsApp.signup.deliveryRefused: Your account is linked, but Meta would not turn on message sending. The setup is saved — contact support instead of going through it again.
manageWhatsApp.signup.numberTaken: That WhatsApp number is already connected to another HatchGrab account. One number can only answer for one food truck. Contact support and we will move it across.
manageWhatsApp.signup.saveIncomplete: Almost done — we could not finish saving. Your setup is saved, contact support instead of going through it again.
manageWhatsApp.signup.connected: WhatsApp is connected. Auto-replies will start answering messages to this number.

customDomain.ready.body: Have a look at the page, then tell us in the settings whether it is right.

customDomain.confirmed.body: There is nothing else to do.

customDomain.turnOff.carriesOn: This carries on exactly as it is, and is where your QR code sends people:

customDomain.turnOff.failed: We could not turn that off just now. Nothing has changed — your address is still working. Try again shortly.
customDomain.wizard.resumeFailedTitle: We could not load your setup.

customDomain.address.intro: Your schedule gets its own web address.
customDomain.address.question: What is your web address?
customDomain.address.hint: The one people already use to find you.
customDomain.address.noChange: Your website does not change — you just add a link to the new address.
customDomain.address.notSetUp: We have not set this up.
customDomain.address.restricted: Whoever looks after your web address must let us set up the padlock — the little lock customers see beside the address. Until they add us it will not appear, so we stopped rather than leave you waiting. Ask them to add us, then try again.
customDomain.address.blocked: Your web address currently blocks the padlock completely. Whoever looks after it must allow it before this can work. Ask them to change that, then try again.
customDomain.address.elsewhere: Something else already answers on that address. Send the message from the next screen to whoever looks after it — they will know what to do.
customDomain.address.provider: Your web address is looked after by {provider}. We will show you where to go.
customDomain.address.provisionFailed: We could not set that address up.
customDomain.address.couldNotBeSetUp: That address could not be set up.
customDomain.apex.empty: Type the address you would like to use.
customDomain.apex.not_a_domain: This does not look like a web address.
customDomain.apex.unparseable: We could not read this as a web address. Check the spelling and try again.
customDomain.apex.apex: {host} is your whole website address. If you point it at us, your website will be replaced by this page. Instead, put a word in front of it — for example nastani.{host}.
customDomain.apex.too_deep: That address has too many parts. Something like nastani.{domain} works best.
customDomain.record.addSomewhere: Add this where your web address is managed, and save.
customDomain.record.hintWord: Just this word, not the whole address.
customDomain.record.timing: It usually starts working within an hour, though it can take longer. You don’t have to keep this page open.
customDomain.record.someoneElse: Someone else looks after your web address?
customDomain.providers.cloudflare.open: Open your web address, then “DNS” and “Records”.
customDomain.providers.cloudflare.add: Select “Add record”, then choose “CNAME” as the “Type”.
customDomain.providers.cloudflare.name: Put the first value below in “Name”.
customDomain.providers.cloudflare.value: Put the second value below in “Target”.
customDomain.providers.cloudflare.proxy: Set “Proxy status” to “DNS only” — the little cloud beside it must be grey, not orange.
customDomain.providers.cloudflare.caveat: If the cloud stays orange, the padlock will never appear and nothing will say why.
customDomain.providers.godaddy.open: Open the “Domain Portfolio” and choose your web address.
customDomain.providers.godaddy.add: Select “Add New Record”, then choose “CNAME” from the “Type” menu.
customDomain.providers.godaddy.name: Put the first value below in “Name”.
customDomain.providers.godaddy.value: Put the second value below in “Value”.
customDomain.providers.godaddy.save: Leave “TTL” as it is and select “Save”.
customDomain.providers.godaddy.caveat: If you added more than one record at once, the button reads “Save All Records”.
customDomain.providers.123reg.signIn: Log in to the “123 Reg Control Panel”.
customDomain.providers.123reg.manage: Beside “Domains”, select “Manage All”, then choose your web address.
customDomain.providers.123reg.name: Put the first value below in “Name”.
customDomain.providers.123reg.value: Put the second value below in “Value” and add a full stop at the end.
customDomain.providers.123reg.caveat: 123 Reg needs a full stop at the end of the second value, otherwise it will not work.
customDomain.providers.wix.open: Open “Domains”, then click the “Domain Actions” icon beside your web address.
customDomain.providers.wix.add: In the “CNAME (Aliases)” section, click “+ Add Record”, then “Got it”.
customDomain.providers.wix.name: Put the first value below in “Host Name”.
customDomain.providers.wix.value: Put the second value below in “Value”.
customDomain.providers.wix.save: Click “Save”, then “Save Changes” in the pop-up window.
customDomain.providers.wix.caveat: If your web address only points at Wix rather than being held there, Wix cannot make this change — whoever holds it has to.
customDomain.instructionsEmail.subject: One record to add for {truckName}’s schedule page
customDomain.instructionsEmail.introAt: We are putting {truckName}’s live schedule on {address}, and for that one record needs adding to our domain at {provider}.
customDomain.instructionsEmail.introHold: We are putting {truckName}’s live schedule on {address}, and for that one record needs adding to our domain with whoever holds the domain.
customDomain.instructionsEmail.wholeChan: That is the whole change — nothing else on the website is affected, and the rest of our domain keeps working exactly as now. It usually starts working within an hour.

customDomain.liveEmail.subject: {address} is working
customDomain.liveEmail.body: Your schedule is now showing at your own address. Have a look and check it is right: open {address} and check that the events are yours and the dates are correct.
customDomain.liveEmail.confirm: Once you have, open the settings in HatchGrab and tell us it is right. Nothing depends on that — it just means we know a person has seen it.
